    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT type) FROM main.sets) AS set_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.sets WHERE type IS NULL) AS missing_types,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.sets WHERE totalSetSize IS NULL) AS missing_sizes,
    COUNT(DISTINCT setCode) AS codes_with_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN TRIM(translation) <> '' THEN setCode END) AS codes_with_names,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT language) AS languages
FROM main.set_translations;

arguments.sql:
WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT setCode
    FROM main.set_translations
    WHERE TRIM(translation) <> ''
)
SELECT
    s.type AS set_type,
    COUNT(t.setCode) AS translated_sets,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN s.totalSetSize ELSE 0 END) AS total_cards
FROM main.sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translated_sets AS t ON t.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type ASC
